interface.name: kde_stereo_content_manager_v1
interface.description:
A program tells the compositor that a surface's picture holds two views, one per eye, packed full side by side, with the left eye first. The compositor renders the declared surface once per eye with that eye's view. The global being present announces support.
Clients may use this protocol to declare stereo content. The version 1 wire values are stable; future requests must use a new interface version. Destroying the manager does not affect declarations it created.

request.name: create

description.summary: Create a stereo content declaration for a surface

request.description: Creates a kde_stereo_content_v1 object for the given surface. The declaration is none until set_content is called. If the surface already has a declaration, the already_declared error is raised.

entry.name: already_declared
entry.summary: the surface already has a stereo content declaration

interface.name: kde_stereo_content_v1

description.summary: stereo content declaration of one surface

interface.description: The declaration of one surface, created with kde_stereo_content_manager_v1.create.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Resets the content to none on the next wl_surface commit. The surface may receive a new declaration immediately.

enum.name: content

description.summary: full side-by-side packing of the two views

enum.description: The values match the X11 property _KDE_NET_WM_STEREO_CONTENT.

entry.name: side_by_side_full
entry.summary: side by side, full width per eye, left first

request.name: set_content
request.description: Takes effect with the next commit of the surface. Unknown values are treated as none. Declaring none clears the format and does not destroy the declaration object.
